## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what is not working in Wordpress.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Interact with '...'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## Environment

Please provide details about your environment:

- **Browser/device**: (e.g., Chrome on Windows, Safari on iPhone, etc.)
- **Wordpress page/plugin/theme**: (if relevant)
- **User role**: (admin, editor, visitor, etc.)
- **Date/Time**: (when did this occur?)
- **Frequency**: (does this happen every time, occasionally, randomly?)

## Screenshots or Logs

If applicable, add screenshots, error messages, or relevant log excerpts.

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here.

## Impact

How does this bug affect your use of Wordpress?

- [ ] Blocking - Cannot use the system
- [ ] High - Major functionality broken
- [ ] Medium - Feature impaired but workaround exists
- [ ] Low - Minor inconvenience
